assignments.purpose: Combat Air Patrol (CAP) north of the support orbits.
restrictions: Do not pursue south of the Cobalt kill box while it is open.
transit_instructions: Enter Falcon at flight level 220 or the flight level assigned by Darkstar.

assignments.purpose: Holding before kill box or tanker entry.
restrictions: No climb or descent in the stack without a Darkstar clearance.
stack_instructions: Assign 14000 or 16000 feet MSL; one flight per level.
Maintain the assigned level until Darkstar clears a climb or descent.
transit_instructions: Join at Marshal at the assigned level; leave via Cedar after release.

assignments.purpose: Keep the kill box closed until the area is clear.
restrictions: No aircraft below 13000 feet MSL in the box while Sweeper clears the area.
transit_instructions: Remain outside the box until the firing window opens.

instructions: All times are UTC. Altimeter: QNH below the Jordanian transition altitude of 13000 feet, standard pressure above.
Use the explicit vertical reference: flight levels use standard pressure; MSL and AGL values are feet. No pressure-to-height conversion is implied. Orbit radials are true bearings.
This order allocates airspace. Flight tasking and permissions to engage remain separate.

banshee-uhf.name: Banshee
banshee-uhf.notes: Banshee gives kill box open and closed calls; read back the status.
banshee-uhf.usage: Kill box status, rescue reservation and procedural control east of H4

cas-alt-uhf.name: Warhawk CAS alternate
cas-alt-uhf.notes: Use when Warhawk CAS is jammed or saturated; Axeman monitors both.
cas-alt-uhf.usage: Alternate CAS check-in and terminal control with Axeman

control-uhf.name: Darkstar control
control-uhf.notes: Primary air control frequency; Link 16 carries the same air picture.

ops-uhf.name: Kingpin
ops-uhf.notes: Monitored 0300Z to 2100Z; outside those hours relay through Darkstar.
ops-uhf.usage: Mission changes, aborts and battle-damage reports

salti-uhf.name: Salti Tower
salti-uhf.usage: Muwaffaq Salti tower, ground and approach (combined)

coordination_instructions: Enter only from Marshal after Banshee reports the box open.
cobalt-box.description: Kill Box (KB) over the Cobalt compound west of the Euphrates, north of the transit and rescue areas.
cobalt-box.name: Cobalt kill box
cobalt-box.notes: Banshee opens the box only after Sweeper reports the area clear of civilian traffic.
cobalt-box.purpose: Air-to-surface attacks on the Cobalt compound and vehicle park.
restrictions: Firing status follows the assignment intervals below; no attacks on the river crossings.

coordination_instructions: Report Falcon on station and off station to Darkstar on 251.000 MHz AM.
falcon.description: Combat air patrol racetrack north of the support orbits, facing the northern threat axis.
falcon.name: Falcon patrol
falcon.purpose: Falcon protects the strike package and the high-value orbits from the north.
restrictions: Remain between FL220 and FL260; do not cross south of Shell without Darkstar approval.

coordination_instructions: Darkstar hands outbound flights to Banshee at Cedar.
gainful-misarc.description: Expected engagement sector of the SA-6 battery toward the Anvil ingress from the south-west.
gainful-misarc.name: Gainful missile arc
restrictions: Inbound only; outbound traffic uses Marshal to Cedar.

ghi.name: Muwaffaq Salti VORTAC
ghi.source: DCS World Syria map: AirfieldsTaxiways layer, radio.lua and beacons.lua

coordination_instructions: Banshee hands inbound flights to Darkstar at Juniper.
juniper.description: Ingress gate west of At Tanf where traffic from Muwaffaq Salti enters the operating area under Darkstar control.
instructions: Report Juniper with altitude and playtime; Darkstar assigns the corridor slot.
juniper.name: Juniper
juniper.notes: Expect a Darkstar picture call at Juniper; squawk the ATO Mode 3 code before the gate.
juniper.position_description: Southwestern ingress gate; beginning of the Juniper-to-Marshal transit corridor.
restrictions: Do not pass Juniper northbound without a Darkstar check-in.

coordination_instructions: Darkstar keeps control from Marshal to the push from holding.
marshal.description: Holding fix at the north end of the transit corridor and the anchor of Mesa holding.
instructions: Report Marshal level; expect a Mesa holding level of 14000 or 16000 feet MSL.
marshal.name: Marshal
marshal.notes: Marshal is the hand-off point from Banshee procedural control to Darkstar.
marshal.position_description: Northern end of the inbound corridor and the reference point for Mesa holding.
restrictions: A Marshal report does not clear a flight into the Cobalt kill box.

coordination_instructions: Leave Mesa only on Darkstar release, via Cedar for recovery or Marshal for the push.
mesa.description: Holding racetrack at Marshal for flights that wait for the kill box or the tanker.
mesa.name: Mesa holding
mesa.purpose: Mesa separates holding flights by level above the transit corridor.
restrictions: One flight per level at 14000 or 16000 feet MSL, as Darkstar assigns.

coordination_instructions: Contact Banshee on 305.000 MHz AM before approaching the boundary.
rescue-reservation.description: Restricted Operating Zone (ROZ) that protects the search for the isolated aircrew of Hawg 2, east of the transit route.
rescue-reservation.name: Rescue reservation
rescue-reservation.notes: Survivor last reported on the eastern edge; Pedro has on-scene command.
rescue-reservation.purpose: Reserve the search area for the rescue package.
restrictions: Other aircraft remain outside until Banshee releases the reservation.

coordination_instructions: Request climb at Marshal; do not climb into the stack without clearance.
south-transit.description: Special Corridor (SC) for the inbound route from Juniper to Marshal, below Mesa holding.
south-transit.name: South transit corridor
south-transit.notes: Maximum 300 knots indicated; outside the period the published Jordanian routes apply.
south-transit.purpose: Keep inbound traffic below the holding stack.
restrictions: Inbound only; outbound traffic uses Marshal to Cedar.

coordination_instructions: Darkstar hands outbound flights to Banshee at Cedar.
zinc-mez.description: Missile engagement zone of the hostile SA-3 site that defends the Zinc depot.
zinc-mez.name: Zinc LOMEZ
restrictions: Inbound only; outbound traffic uses Marshal to Cedar.

sa6-gainful.name: Cobalt SA-6 battery (captured)
sa6-gainful.remarks: Relocates up to 5 nautical miles after it emits; last seen on the river road north of Cobalt.

remarks: Tower combines ground, tower and approach on 253.15 and 120.5; BAK-12 cables 1500 feet from both runway 13 and 31 thresholds.
Transient fighters park on stands 40 and 41; shelters are at the north-west end.
